profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer
profile.summary: Principal Software Engineer with more than 13 years of experience designing, developing and releasing secured REST APIs, microservices, and web applications using .NET/.NET Core, C#, Angular, JavaScript, TypeScript, SQL, cloud technologies (Azure, Azure AD, Azure DevOps, Azure Functions, Redis Cache, Azure API Management, Interoperability/FHIR), well known authentication and authorization protocols (OIDC and OAuth) libraries (MSAL, ADAL). Also, strong experience in Clean Architecture and Domain Drive Design (DDD). Solid experience in Agile methodologies (Scrum framework). Strong vision for automating business processes to save companies money, increase productivity, minimize user error and operation issues. Strong communication skills, especially when working with business and product owners and translating their needs into software solutions. Fast learner, self-taught and passionate about technology and its applications to deliver business value and continuous improvements.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed and implemented multiple enterprise-level microservices for Health Care and Medicare Advantage (e.g., Enrollment, Membership, Grievance & Appeals, Sales, OTC, Provider, HIE, FHIR) using the latest of Azure cloud technologies (AD, API Gateway, Redis Cache, Functions, Queues, Storage), C#, .NET Core, EF Core and MSSQL.
•	Led the development of several E2E and API integrations with multiple partners e.g., CMS (MARx, DTRR, BEQ), NIPR (Brokers), Checkr (Background Checks) from the requirements to implementation and configuration of metrics capturing, alarms, and dashboards. 
•	Designed and developed multiple web apps using Asp.NET Core, EF Core, MSSQL, Angular, Angular Material, and Bootstrap and created configurable dynamic forms saving up to 80% of development time, ensuring consistent behavior and validations. 
•	Automated multiple business processes increasing productivity, reducing human interaction and human error by more than 60%. 
•       Implemented reusable libraries used across apps for authentication, authorization, HTTP messaging, error handling, and logging. 
•	Led and implemented Continuous Integration/Deployments, pull requests, code reviews, unit/integration/e2e/load testing. 
•	As part of a Scrum development team, I mentored new and less experienced team members and created team coding guidelines.
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Project Leadership · Agile Methodologies · .NET Framework · Domain-Driven Design (DDD) · Language Integrated Query (LINQ) · Software Development · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Microsoft SQL Server · JavaScript · Moq · C# · AutoMapper · SQL · ASP.NET MVC · ASP.NET Core · OpenID Connect (OIDC) · Azure AD · xUnit · XML · Visual Studio · JSON · Web Development · Azure Functions · Databases · HTML · OAuth · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Angular · Test Driven Development

positions.title: Sr. Techoncal Scrum Master
positions.description:
•	Helped the team implement Scrum and improve its development, DevOps, and testing practices while increasing its velocity by 50%.
•      Helped with the development, testing, and release of a mobile app and microservices using .NET, Redis Cache, MSSQL, and SSO.
•	Designed and executed load and automation tests using LoadRunner, SoapUI, Postman, and VSTS increasing the product quality.
•	Worked closely with the Product Owner on the Product Backlog grooming and prioritization and facilitated all Scrum events. 
•	Led the implementation of Azure DevOps (formerly VSTS) for all Scrum teams across the organization.
•	As a technical team member, I was able to contribute with most aspects of the SDLC and get hands on where needed.
•	I build numerous dashboards and queries to help increase the team productivity and collaboration.
•	I helped the team resolve conflicts and understand the Scrum processes as well as work together on 
        clearing impediments.
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Project Leadership · Agile Methodologies · Software Development · Project Management · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · JavaScript · Scrum Master · Quality Assurance · SQL · XML · Visual Studio · JSON · Web Development · Databases · HTML · SoapUI

positions.title: Software Developer/Scrum Master
positions.description:
•	Helped the organization implement Scrum, introduced VSTS/Azure DevOps and continuous Integration and Deployments.
•	Led the implementation of multiple REST APIs and internal web app to manage and track file imports/exports using .NET, EF, and SQL
•	Automated API functional testing using SoapUI and performance testing using LoadRunner.
•	Designed, implemented and maintained an Automation framework using Selenium, Spring, Maven, Git, Jenkins, TFS, TestNG, and Cucumber.
•	Contributed to the design and implementation of the Edifecs integration for Claims and Encounter modules (member/provider search).
•	Worked closely with Product Owners on building and prioritizing different product backlogs and managing dependencies across the program.
•	Facilitated Scrum events (Planning, Daily Standup, Review, Retro, Refinement) and coordinated them across different teams to avoid conflicts regarding schedule, resources, and priorities.
•	Coached team members on Team Collaboration, Software Development, Automation Testing, and Scrum principles, increasing their self-organization and Sprint Velocity.
•	Embraced the adoption of standard QA and Automation processes across all implementation and products.
•	Led, design, implemented, and executed Performance tests for various applications and components.
•	Contributed with different projects for multiple back-end systems integration (ESB), claim Intake, 
           HIPAA validation, claim pre-processing Edits, claim Upload to Adjudication Systems, misdirected 
           Claims, Encounter Management, Enrollment Implementation, Payment & Remittance, and others 
           saving the organization millions of dollars and increasing their client satisfaction.
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Project Leadership · Agile Methodologies · Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) · Software Development · Project Management · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · JavaScript · Scrum Master · Quality Assurance · SQL · jQuery · ASP.NET MVC · XML · Visual Studio · JSON · Web Development · Java · Databases · HTML · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Spring MVC · Maven · SoapUI · Test Driven Development

positions.title: Software Engineer/ Full Stack Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Contributed with the implementation of Espresso, a multimillion-dollar web app and its APIs using Java, Spring, and AngularJS, Apache Tiles, and Thymeleaf.
•	Implemented a new loyalty rewards program module integrated with internal and third-party REST APIs using Java, Spring Web Flow.
•	Helped on the rewrite of different modules of the legacy application (Cruise Match) to incorporate them into Espresso. 
•	Extracted current business logic and rules from both business and legacy systems and implemented them into the new application.
•	Worked extensively in the bug fixing efforts which helped me understand a large portion of the application, design patters, and performed extensive automated regression tests and performance improvements.
•	Used Jenkins for continuous integration and deployments as part of the daily builds and deployments and performed code reviews.
•	Environment and server setup of the application being developed or to communicate with other apps and servers such as WebSphere, and Tomcat.
•	Implemented and executed unit tests using Junit and TestNG and designed and executed performance and load tests. 
•	As a cross functional team member, I contributed with the functional and nonfunctional defect detection, correction, and automation testing helping the team achieve a higher level of productivity and product quality.

positions.title: System Integration, Automation & Performance Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed, developed multiple automation scripts using Java, JavaScript, C, Selenium and SoapUI for several enterprise web apps and REST APIs.
•	Wrote SQL queries and integrated them into LoadRunner scripts to automate database tests and built execution result reports.
•	Trained team members on automation and performance test processes and tools.
•	Designed, scripted, and executed several types of load and performance tests for several projects and enterprise applications.
•	Led performance and load tests for different technologies such as web/REST services, data flows, database processes and jobs, web apps, and AS-400.
•	Worked with offshore team members to optimize the delivery timeline by assigning them portion of the test scripts after they were designed and documented by Business Analyst and myself.
•	Contributed with the administration of Quality Center and version migrations.
•	Created standard libraries and scripts for SoapUI (Java & Groovy) and LoadRunner (C, JavaScript) increasing consistency and team productivity.
•	Created multiple scripts to automate business processes for both shipboard and shore side applications.
•	Designed and developed multiple scripts for complex scenarios test data generation for QA teams across the organization saving thousands of dollars and resources.

positions.title: Java/Android Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Worked on an Android mobile application for the Miami Beach Convention Center Visitor Authority
•	Designed and developed all layers of different modules of the application using Java, Android SDK and SQL Lite 
•	Created and execute several automated unit tests using Junit for functionality developed by other team members and myself
•	Interacted with new set of REST services provided by the city of Miami Beach to support the application functionality
•	Provided application status to client and management in a timely matter using test execution reports
•	Used Scrum for the first time to deliver this product and respond to constant changes due to API and requirement changes
•	Contributed with the documentation and parts of the user manual
•	Wrote user stories and provided demo to the stakeholders taking feedback and converting it into new User Stories or grooming existing ones
•	Design UI interfaces and applied styling to them as well as testing it using different device emulator screen sizes
•	Use Git and Github for version control management and team collaboration
•	Led the QA activities and provided support to other team members regarding test management and defect tracking and resolution
•	Created and documented test cases and follow TDD methodologies to test class functionality in isolation
•	Played the team lead role and helped them keep focused on the project vision, goals and deliverables
•	As the team lead (Scrum like), I ensure team coordination, collaboration and schedule planning in a daily and weekly basis
•	Implemented 1 week sprints to ensure quality working software at the end of each week to demo to the product owner
•	Helped the team understand Scrum principles and agile testing
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Project Leadership · Agile Methodologies · Android Development · Software Development · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · JavaScript · SQL · XML · JSON · Java · Databases · MySQL · HTML · SQLite

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Worked on a Java GUI based product for a molecular interaction with extensive graphics development using Eclipse, AWT, swing, and JDBC
•	Contributed with the team mainly as a tester using Junit automated tests
•	Documented application use cases using UML diagrams and created test cases to test the different variations
•	Created positive and negative test cases to test application data boundaries
•	Created CRUD, UI and integration manual and automated test cases to guarantee product high quality
•	Created several manual and automated regression tests to ensure the health of the application after changes to current functionality
•	Contributed with the defect detection, tracking, and closure processes
•	Played an important role on the issue research and resolution processes and helped fixing some of them by writing code to fix defects
•	Created test code artifacts to facilitate development tests
•	Built and provided weekly defect status report and improved them in a standard manned following best practices
•	Implemented and maintained Test Traceability Matrix to keep track of requirements validation progress
•	After a few months, I started contributing with development towards more complex defect fixing and application support
•	Designed and developed different complex rules using Java and a well-known design pattern, MVC
•	Used PostgreSQL as the back-end system for CRUD operations and created and executed test cases for them
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · JavaScript · JSON · Java · Databases
